meta.name: CampusFest next-edition sponsorship cash model
meta.objective: Expected sponsorship CASH collected before the festival opens (INR). In-kind value never enters cash.
meta.levels: bau = repeat the 2025 playbook; base = realistic plan; stretch = ambitious plan
meta.label_legend: [SOURCE] dataset fact, [CALCULATED] derived from dataset, [ASSUMPTION] planning assumption

cash_share_of_committed_value.label: [CALCULATED]
cash_share_of_committed_value.basis: 2025 confirmed cash-type value / total confirmed value = 2,000,000 / 2,240,000 = 0.893 (pre-festival cutoff)

post_signing_withdrawal_rate.label: [CALCULATED]/[ASSUMPTION]
post_signing_withdrawal_rate.basis: 2025: 1 of 25 opportunities that ever reached partner_confirmed later withdrew (O006) = 4%. Stretch assumes signed-contract discipline cuts this to 3%.

closers.label: [SOURCE]/[ASSUMPTION]
closers.basis: 2025 had 4 named owners (T01, T02, T03, T05). Plan adds 1 (base) / 2 (stretch) closers.

proposals_per_closer.label: [CALCULATED]/[ASSUMPTION]
proposals_per_closer.basis: 2025: 46 proposals over ~10 active weeks across 3 opportunity owners (~15 each). A 16-week season at the same weekly pace = ~20 per closer.

collection.bau_basis: 2025 had no invoice, milestone or receipt records at all. Without a collection process we assume 70% of net cash-type commitments arrive before the festival.
phases: early: signed T-16 to T-9 weeks
mid: signed T-8 to T-4 weeks
late: signed T-3 to T-0 weeks
collection.label: [ASSUMPTION]
collection.basis: With the Cash Collection Desk: 50% advance invoiced within 48h of signing, balance due T-7 days. 2025 confirmations were spread over 8 weeks (Feb 10 - Apr 6), so most signings can land early/mid.

upsell.label: [ASSUMPTION]
upsell.basis: Add-on menu (sampling stall, stage branding, digital pack) sold to signed cash sponsors. Applied to expected signed cash-type deals.

sources.name: 2025 sponsor renewals
sources.basis: [SOURCE] 24 brands confirmed in 2025 (20 cash, 4 in-kind). Rates are [ASSUMPTION]: no renewal history exists. Deal uplift from a tier ladder [ASSUMPTION]; 2025 avg confirmed cash deal = 100,000 [CALCULATED].

sources.name: Qualified-but-unpitched 2025 brands
sources.basis: [CALCULATED] 18 brands whose latest status was 'qualified' at the cutoff but had no opportunity. 13 of 18 came from warm/inbound sources. Rates [ASSUMPTION], haircut vs warm history.

sources.name: Inbound partner page / form
sources.basis: [CALCULATED] 2025 Partner Interest Form: 17 brands, 13 met, 7 proposals, 7 confirmed; avg cash deal 105,833. Rates are warm-history haircuts [ASSUMPTION].

sources.name: Alumni & sponsor referral engine
sources.basis: [CALCULATED] 2025 Warm Partner Introductions: 8 brands, 8 met, 9 proposals, 8 confirmed (96% of proposals); avg cash deal 106,667. Forward rates halve the historical brand-to-signed yield (54.5% -> 26.8% base) [ASSUMPTION].

sources.name: Creator & community referral network
sources.basis: [CALCULATED] 2025 Creator Network Referrals: 19 brands, 15 met, 9 proposals, 9 confirmed; avg cash deal 90,625. Forward rates are haircuts [ASSUMPTION].

sources.name: Cold outbound (email / LinkedIn / revival)
sources.basis: [CALCULATED] 2025 cold channels: 148 brands, 24 met (16%), 21 proposals, 1 confirmation which later withdrew; 0 confirmed at cutoff. A non-zero win rate is a generous [ASSUMPTION]. Plan cuts volume to a 40-brand, meeting-gated ABM test.

sources.name: Anchor / title-tier prospects (stretch only)
sources.basis: [ASSUMPTION] No 2025 deal exceeded 200,000. Excluded from base so the plan never depends on a title sponsor; stretch carries only its expected value (0.5 deals) across 8 prospects.

initiatives.name: Cash Collection Desk
initiatives.concept: Milestone billing (50% advance in 48h, balance T-7), invoice-on-signature, overdue escalation ladder, receipt verification.
initiatives.experiment: W1-W4: invoice every signed deal within 48h; compare days-to-first-payment against 7-day goal.
initiatives.scale: >=80% of due cash received on time by W6
initiatives.change: 60-80% on time: switch to 100% advance for late signers, CFO-level escalation
initiatives.stop: Never stop; if <60% on time, reassign closers to collections for 1 week

initiatives.name: Renewal, Tiering & Upsell Sprint
initiatives.concept: Proof-of-performance recap to all 24 2025 sponsors with a 3-tier rate card (Associate / Category / Activation) and an add-on menu.
initiatives.experiment: First 8 renewal pitches: A/B the tier anchor (lead with Category vs Associate tier).
initiatives.scale: >=50% of first 8 pitches convert to proposal within 2 weeks
initiatives.change: 25-50%: shorten deck, lead with 2025 proof, offer early-renewal discount <=10%
initiatives.stop: <25% after 12 pitches: stop tier upsell, renew at 2025 price

initiatives.name: Qualified-Lead Recovery + Inbound Partner Page
initiatives.timeline: W1-W4 recovery blitz; page live W2, runs to W14
initiatives.concept: Pitch the 18 qualified-but-never-pitched brands within 10 days; publish a partner page with rate card and 2025 proof to lift inbound volume.
initiatives.experiment: Proposal to all 18 within 10 days; track proposal->meeting conversion and inbound submissions per week.
initiatives.scale: >=6 of 18 recovery proposals in negotiation by W4; >=2 inbound/week
initiatives.change: 3-5 in negotiation: re-qualify decision maker; refresh page CTA
initiatives.stop: <3 by W4: return brands to nurture; <1 inbound/week by W6: stop page spend

initiatives.name: Alumni & Sponsor Referral Engine
initiatives.concept: Map alumni in marketing/partnership roles plus every renewed sponsor; ask each for 2 warm intros using a referral kit; recognise referrers (VIP passes, stage credit).
initiatives.experiment: Pilot with first 30 alumni asks: measure intros per ask and intro->meeting rate.
initiatives.scale: >=0.4 intros per ask and >=70% intro->meeting by W5
initiatives.change: 0.2-0.4 intros/ask: tighten targeting to alumni in brand-marketing roles; add sponsor-to-sponsor referrals
initiatives.stop: <0.2 intros per ask after 60 asks: redeploy alumni lead to renewals

initiatives.name: Creator & Community Referral Network
initiatives.variable_cost: 8% finder fee on cash RECEIVED (paid only after receipt)
initiatives.concept: Recruit campus creators and community partners who already work with youth brands; pay a finder fee only on collected cash.
initiatives.experiment: Onboard 10 creators by W4; measure qualified brand referrals per creator.
initiatives.scale: >=1.5 qualified referrals per creator by W6
initiatives.change: 0.75-1.5: narrow to creators with brand-deal history
initiatives.stop: <0.75 per creator by W6 or finder fees >12% of attributed cash

deprioritised.name: Scale cold email / LinkedIn / revival
deprioritised.reason: [CALCULATED] 148 brands touched in 2025 produced 0 confirmed partnerships at cutoff (1 confirmation later withdrew) and 7 opt-outs. Kept only as a 40-brand, meeting-gated ABM test.

deprioritised.name: Bet the plan on one title sponsor
deprioritised.reason: No 2025 deal exceeded 200,000; one anchor deal would be a concentration risk with a long sales cycle. Anchor tier appears in stretch only, at expected value.

deprioritised.name: Chase the stale cold open pipeline
deprioritised.reason: [CALCULATED] 26 open opportunities (1,440,000 face value) are all cold-originated; 25 have sat in their stage >14 days (median 43 days). One final 'close or disqualify' touch, then archive.

deprioritised.name: Paid ads for sponsor leads
deprioritised.reason: No spend data exists to validate CAC; sponsorship buyers are a few hundred marketers reachable via warm paths.
